exercises.instruction: Rewrite these sentences, using the words on the right in the correct form. The meaning must stay the same.
items: 1 I did a training course last week.
2 The boss dismissed him when he heard about the scandal.
3 She quit her job because of the long hours.
4 I am now in charge of both departments.
5 In his job he has to travel a lot.
6 I was very well paid in my last job.

exercises.instruction: Decide whether the pairs of sentences have the same meaning or a different meaning.
items: 1 a) They gave him a lot of training when he started in the job.
b) They organised a lot of help and advice when he started the job.
2 a) She was given a pay rise at the end of the year.
b) She was dismissed at the end of the year.
3 a) He decided it was time to take control of the sister company.
b) He decided it was time to take over the sister company.
4 a) I've been out of work for weeks.
b) I've been unemployed for weeks.
5 a) The company has decided to sack him.
b) The company has decided to promote him.
6 a) She's going to leave and look for an easier job.
b) She's going to leave and look for a fresh challenge.

exercises.instruction: Correct the mistake in each sentence.
items: 1 I'd like to apply that job, but I don't think I'll get it.
2 He got a job like a manager in the shoe department.
3 He's going to be retire at the age of 60.
4 We are giving him a training to help him.
5 He promoted and they gave him a pay rise.
6 I'm looking for a half-time job but I'll take anything which is interesting.

exercises.instruction: Fill the gaps with a suitable word.
items: 1 I didn't .......................... much money in my last job but I'm well paid now.
2 He works very hard for the company and his future .......................... look good.
3 I've decided to retire .......................... the age of 55.
4 I've got an interesting job which .......................... working with young people.
5 I've been unemployed for two months and I'm .......................... for work.
6 If I was very unhappy I would probably .......................... from the company and work from home.
